# Medanta

> India's #1 ranked multispecialty hospital network offering advanced cardiac, cancer, and neurological care with cutting-edge robotic surgery and organ transplant capabilities.

Medanta operates multiple JCI-accredited hospitals across India (Gurugram, Noida, Lucknow, Patna, Indore) with 900+ specialist doctors and comprehensive treatment options. The network combines advanced medical technology with patient education resources to deliver world-class healthcare services.

## Key Topics

- Multispecialty Care
- Cardiac Care
- Cancer Care
- Neurosciences
- Robotic Surgery
- Orthopaedics
- Gastrosciences
- Renal Care
- Organ Transplant
- Minimally Invasive Surgery
- Medical Technology
- JCI Accreditation
- Surgical Robotics
- Patient Education
- Telemedicine

## Hospital Locations & Network

- [Medanta - India's #1 Best Hospital](https://www.medanta.org): Medanta homepage: India's #1 ranked hospital with cardiac & cancer care
- [Medanta Gurugram](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/gurugram-hospital): JCI-accredited multispecialty hospital with 900+ doctors and 30+ superspecialties
- [Medanta Noida](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/noida-hospital): 550-bed tertiary care facility with surgical robotics and advanced infrastructure
- [Medanta Lucknow](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/lucknow-hospital): 40+ specialty super specialty hospital in Uttar Pradesh
- [Medanta Indore](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/indore-hospital): Central India's superspecialty hospital for heart & neuro care
- [Jay Prabha Medanta Patna](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/patna-hospital): Public-private partnership with cardiac & oncology specialization in Bihar
- [Medanta Mediclinics](https://www.medanta.org/mediclinics): Primary healthcare clinics across Gurugram for comprehensive preventive care

## Medical Specialties

- [Cardiology & Heart Care](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/gurugram-hospital/speciality/cardiology): Expert heart care for bypass, angioplasty, arrhythmia with advanced interventional techniques
- [Oncology & Cancer Care](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/gurugram-hospital/speciality/oncology): Advanced cancer care for breast, lung, blood & prostate cancers with personalized treatment
- [Neurosciences & Neurology](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/gurugram-hospital/speciality/neurology): Expert treatment for stroke, epilepsy, brain tumors and neurological disorders
- [Orthopedics](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/gurugram-hospital/speciality/orthopaedics): Joint replacement, arthritis management and sports injury treatment
- [Gastroenterology & Gastrosciences](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/gurugram-hospital/speciality/gastroenterology): Specialist care for stomach, liver, pancreas and digestive system disorders
- [Urology, Nephrology & Renal Care](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/gurugram-hospital/speciality/urology-nephrology): Robotic urology for prostate cancer, kidney disease and renal transplant
- [All Specialties Directory](https://www.medanta.org/hospitals-near-me/gurugram-hospital/speciality): Complete directory of 30+ superspecialties including organ transplant services

## Medical Technology & Innovation

- [Cutting-Edge Medical Technology](https://www.medanta.org/technology): Advanced medical technology: CyberKnife, CT scan, robotic surgery systems and minimally invasive equipment

## Patient Resources & Education

- [Patient Education & Health Tips](https://www.medanta.org/patient-education): Expert blogs on treatments, procedures, wellness tips and preventive healthcare
- [Health Library](https://www.medanta.org/health-library): Medical conditions reference guide: osteoarthritis, frozen shoulder, disc prolapse and more
- [Ailments Directory](https://www.medanta.org/ailments): Alphabetical index of diseases, symptoms, and treatment options
- [Treatment Information](https://www.medanta.org/treatment): Comprehensive treatment directory: surgical procedures, cosmetic surgery, oncology options
